lines.beaver: 어서 와요. 요즘 학업은 어떻게 되어 가요?
lines.beaver_en: Come in. How are your studies going these days?
lines.beaver_roman: eoseo wayo. yojeum hageobeun eotteoke doeeo gayo?
lines.learner: 대입 준비 때문에 반 분위기가 아주 무거워요.
lines.en: Because of university entrance prep, my class feels very heavy.
lines.roman: daeip junbi ttaemune ban bunwigiga aju mugeowoyo.

lines.beaver: 그래요? 수험 분위기를 좀 설명해 주겠어요?
lines.beaver_en: Really? Could you describe the exam atmosphere a bit?
lines.beaver_roman: geuraeyo? suheom bunwigireul jom seolmyeonghae jugesseoyo?
lines.en: Everyone studies until late at night.

lines.beaver_en: Is your exam prep going well?
lines.learner: 네, 그런데 기말이 다가와서 성적 걱정이 큰 친구도 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, but finals are coming, so some friends worry a lot about grades.
lines.roman: ne, geureonde gimari dagawaseo seongjeok geokjeongi keun chingudo isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Does the school offer any extra help?
lines.learner: 네, 논술 특강과 대입 강좌가 새로 개설됐어요.
lines.en: Yes, an essay special lecture and entrance courses just opened.
lines.roman: ne, nonsul teukganggwa daeip gangjwaga saero gaeseoldwaesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: How is the special lecture run?
lines.learner: 시청각 자료로 문항 푸는 법을 배워요.
lines.en: We learn how to solve questions with audiovisual materials.
lines.roman: sicheonggak jaryoro munhang puneun beobeul baewoyo.

lines.learner: 공부 시간이 길어서 오후엔 집중력이 떨어져요.
lines.en: Study hours are long, so my focus drops in the afternoon.
lines.roman: gongbu sigani gireoseo ohuen jipjungnyeogi tteoreojyeoyo.

lines.beaver: 공부와 시험에 대해 더 얘기해 줄래요?
lines.beaver_en: Can you tell me more about studying and exams?
lines.beaver_roman: gongbuwa siheome daehae deo yaegihae jullaeyo?
lines.learner: 모의시험 날엔 입실 시간이 엄격해서 다들 긴장해요.
lines.en: On mock exam days, entry time is strict, so everyone is tense.
lines.roman: mouisiheom naren ipsil sigani eomgyeokaeseo dadeul ginjanghaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: That must be tough. How about you?
lines.learner: 방학 특강에서 공부법을 익혀서 좀 나아요.
lines.en: I learned study methods in a vacation lecture, so it's a bit better.
lines.roman: banghak teukgangeseo gongbubeobeul ikyeoseo jom naayo.

lines.beaver_en: How does the top student in your class study?
lines.beaver_roman: baneseo ildeung haneun haksaengeun eotteoke gongbuhaeyo?
lines.learner: 수석인 친구는 노트를 꼼꼼히 정리하고 공유도 해 줘요.
lines.en: The top student takes careful notes and shares them too.
lines.roman: suseogin chinguneun noteureul kkomkkomhi jeongnihago gongyudo hae jwoyo.

lines.beaver: 분위기가 잘 전해졌어요. 힘들면 또 찾아와요.
lines.beaver_en: I get the atmosphere now. Come again if it gets hard.
lines.beaver_roman: bunwigiga jal jeonhaejyeosseoyo. himdeulmyeon tto chajawayo.
lines.en: Thank you, professor. I'll do my best to the end.
